changelog:
Cinema Insider Top-10 Skill 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches an advanced digest of the top 10 most impactful movie and TV industry news stories with automated aggregation, deduplication, and analysis.
- Integrates curated, high-quality sources (e.g., Variety, Deadline, Hollywood Reporter) to ensure comprehensive, verified coverage.
- Classifies news into categories (Production, Business, Casting, Marketing) and ranks items by industry significance.
- Provides analytical commentary and direct source links, with extra verification and detail for breaking stories.
- Supports capture and preview of visual assets (trailers, posters) for highly visual news items.
summary: Professional analytical digest of top 10 movie and TV industry news using advanced AI aggregation and cross-referencing.
